title: cFS/NOS3 space_platform Security Benchmark Scenario Index

scenarios.name: cFS app crash and restart pressure

description.attack_entry: Space platform app runtime / cFE Executive Services
description.affected_component: cFS app process, cFE ES restart and exception handling
description.security_consequence: A faulty or malicious app can crash repeatedly and reduce availability of mission functions
description.recovery_strategy: App restart limits, health monitoring, memory protection, cFE/FSW respawn or safe mode after repeated faults
description.injection_method: Send BENCH_VICTIM_INJECT_FAULT through COSMOS/CI, let the cFS app exit with APP_ERROR, then observe cFE/FSW recovery and BENCH_VICTIM telemetry returning

scenarios.notes: Live mode uses the benchmark cFS app pair installed into NOS3; dry mode still emits the scenario artifact for documentation.

scenarios.name: Malformed TC parser and command handler input

description.attack_entry: Space platform TC parser / command handler boundary
description.affected_component: CI, cFE command dispatcher, app command handlers
description.security_consequence: Malformed or dangerous command input can trigger error paths, invalid command handling, or parser faults
description.recovery_strategy: Strict packet validation, command length checks, function code allowlists, error counter monitoring
description.injection_method: In dry-run mode generate malformed TC payload bytes; in live mode send malformed BENCH_ATTACK/BENCH_VICTIM commands through COSMOS/CI and verify cFS command error counters increase while spoof delivery is blocked

scenarios.notes: Focuses on parser and handler robustness rather than RF-link transport behavior.

scenarios.name: Payload critical interface abuse

description.attack_entry: Space platform payload or PDHS interface
description.affected_component: BENCH_PAYLOAD app, PDHS boundary, bus-payload link
description.security_consequence: Unauthorized payload commands can trigger unsafe collection modes or unexpected data movement
description.recovery_strategy: Payload command authorization, critical-command confirmation, interface rate limits
description.injection_method: In dry-run mode generate a critical payload command artifact; in live mode send BENCH_PAYLOAD_START_COLLECTION without arming and verify the cFS payload guard rejects it

scenarios.notes: Live execution models a legal-format but unauthorized critical payload command and expects the payload state-machine guard to reject it.

scenarios.name: OBSW runtime resource exhaustion

description.affected_component: cFS Software Bus, BENCH_ATTACK, BENCH_VICTIM, app runtime
description.security_consequence: Resource pressure can starve flight software tasks or prevent logging and recovery actions
description.recovery_strategy: Resource quotas, app isolation, event throttling, watchdog recovery, safe mode
description.injection_method: In dry-run mode generate a pressure plan; in live mode trigger bounded BENCH_ATTACK Software Bus flood and validate recovery by HK/NOOP telemetry

scenarios.notes: Live execution is opt-in and bounded; it should demonstrate pressure and post-attack recovery without intentionally crashing NOS3.

scenarios.name: Scheduler manipulation and timing disruption

description.affected_component: BENCH_SCHED app, BENCH_PERIODIC telemetry model, Software Bus tick message
description.security_consequence: Missed or reordered periodic tasks can cause stale telemetry, delayed control, or watchdog pressure
description.recovery_strategy: Schedule table validation, watchdogs, missed-deadline telemetry, fallback schedules
description.injection_method: Live cFS benchmark scheduler app disables a Software Bus tick, periodic task reports missed deadlines through HK telemetry

scenarios.notes: Stable verifiable version. It models scheduler manipulation with one benchmark cFS app that exposes scheduler and periodic-task telemetry before replacing the injected control path with real SCH table edits.

scenarios.name: Software Bus spoofed internal message

description.attack_entry: Space platform internal interface / cFS Software Bus
description.affected_component: cFE SB, subscribed cFS apps, mission application message handlers
description.security_consequence: A malicious or compromised app can impersonate an internal publisher and drive unsafe app behavior
description.recovery_strategy: Message authorization, app isolation, message ID allowlists, event monitoring, safe mode triggers
description.injection_method: In dry-run mode generate a spoofed SB message artifact; in live mode send BENCH_ATTACK_SEND_SPOOF through COSMOS/CI and verify BENCH_VICTIM receives BENCH_SPOOF_INTERNAL_MID through cFE SB telemetry

scenarios.notes: Live execution requires the bench_spoof cFS apps installed into NOS3 startup and TO telemetry tables.

scenarios.name: Satellite subsystem state spoofing

description.affected_component: EPS state model, subsystem telemetry consumer, plausibility monitor
description.security_consequence: Spoofed subsystem state can mislead control logic or mission operations decisions
description.recovery_strategy: Redundant sensing, state estimation, plausibility checks, cross-subsystem consistency checks
description.injection_method: Live cFS benchmark app publishes plausible and spoofed EPS states, then reports plausibility failures through HK telemetry

scenarios.notes: Stable verifiable version. It models subsystem state spoofing inside the benchmark cFS app before replacing the injected state source with a real NOS3 subsystem simulator path.

scenarios.name: Table and configuration tampering

description.affected_component: cFE TBL, mission app configuration tables, control parameters
description.security_consequence: Modified configuration can shift thresholds, disable checks, or change control behavior
description.recovery_strategy: Table validation, checksums, signed uploads, rollback to known-good tables
description.injection_method: In dry-run mode generate a tampered table artifact; in live mode load /cf/bench_bad.tbl through cFE TBL commands and verify BENCH_VICTIM validation rejects the active table update

scenarios.notes: Live execution uses cFE TBL validation and BENCH_VICTIM HK telemetry as the primary evidence path.
